summary: This X-ray of your chest shows that your lungs and heart appear normal. However, there is an unusual finding where a section of your large intestine (bowel) is located between your liver and your right diaphragm (the muscle that helps you breathe). This is known as Chilaiditi's sign. It's often an incidental finding, meaning it's seen by chance and usually doesn't cause any problems or symptoms. In some cases, it can be associated with discomfort, but this X-ray alone cannot determine if you are experiencing symptoms from it. Your doctor will consider these findings along with your medical history.
